changelog: Security: a single unauthenticated request could stop the backend or a remote agent (body-parser GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828). Fixed by body-parser 1.20.9. Remote agents keep the old copy until their install command is re-run from the Servers page.
Dependency updates: multer 2.5.0, nodemailer 10.3.1 (alert recipient parsing), follow-redirects 1.16.2, qs 6.16.2, axios 1.21.0, vite 7.3.7 and build-tool refreshes.
CI now audits all dependencies on every change and daily; regression tests cover each fixed advisory.
